findings.title: Upgrade blocks reads and writes on large encrypted tables while every captured index is rebuilt inside one transaction
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same mechanism as F-02, confirmed in the code: one transaction holds the ACCESS EXCLUSIVE locks from the cascade drop through the plain CREATE INDEX rebuilds and ANALYZE until COMMIT.

findings.title: Upgrade now fails, where it used to succeed, when the installer role does not own the indexed customer tables
findings.label: valid
findings.note: CASCADE drops dependants without per-object ownership checks, but the replayed CREATE INDEX needs table ownership; preflight checks only EQL schema drop rights, and index.ts wraps the resulting error as a generic rollback.

findings.title: An upgrade that changes or removes an EQL function used by an existing index can no longer complete
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Captured definitions are replayed verbatim and verification requires an exact pg_get_indexdef match, so a future bundle that changes an index-referenced function makes the upgrade fail and roll back where base succeeded.
